name: second-opinion
description: Six skills built on one premise: a single model's confident answer is not evidence. llm-council runs a question through five advisors who analyse independently before synthesis; plan-arbiter compares, judges, and merges competing plans rather than picking one on vibes; spec-review checks a spec's claims against the real codebase before code is written, catching wrong data-model assumptions early; agent-watchdog audits another agent's work from its session or transcript; debug-feedback-loop builds a deterministic pass/fail signal for a bug BEFORE hypothesising about causes; and efficient-frontier-routing keeps small tasks local, sends routine work to cheaper subagents, and escalates difficult decisions or risky reviews to a stronger model.

capabilities: Runs a decision past five independent advisors before synthesising
Compares and merges competing plans instead of picking one arbitrarily
Verifies a spec's claims against the actual codebase before implementation
Audits another agent's work from its session or transcript
Builds a deterministic reproduction signal before hypothesising about a bug
Routes each piece of work to the cheapest suitable model and escalates risky calls to a stronger one
